math_or_source_observation: The net realizes half of a12-side cube cut by x+y+z=18. The cut is a regular hexagon through six edge midpoints, leaving three pentagonal A faces and three triangular B faces. Central symmetry divides cube volume in half:12^3/2=864.
reason_no_design: True A/B cut-edge pairing helps recover the half-cube. A false pairing designed to yield1728 would suggest closing a different solid or restoring full square faces, conflicting with the visible net. No semantically clean wrong net correspondence selected.
